purpose: Conservative recipe shortlist for assembling a DASH eating pattern, not clinical certification or a full-day plan
threshold_basis: Application screening limits chosen conservatively for the prototype; not official NHLBI per-recipe cutoffs
guidance: Favor vegetables, fruits, grains (especially whole grains), legumes, low-fat dairy, lean proteins, and vegetable oils.
Limit saturated fats, sweetened beverages and sweets.
Daily sodium and food-group targets must be checked separately at plan level.
excluded_for_this_shortlist: Recipes requiring unsupported substitutions or nutrition recalculation
Unverified amounts, missing cooking steps, or missing sodium/saturated-fat values
